organization_role.townstead.member.descr: A recognized member of the organization.
organization_role.townstead.officer.desc: May review membership business and act for the organization.
organization_role.townstead.founder.desc: Established the organization and holds its initial charter authority.
organization_role.townstead.councilor.de: Shares responsibility for governing the local faction.
organization_role.townstead.presiding_co: Chairs the council and may formally represent its faction.
organization_kind.townstead.civic_factio: A political association that can organize members and seek public influence.
organization_kind.townstead.guild.descri: A nonexclusive association formed around a shared trade or calling.
organization_kind.townstead.village_coun: The council responsible for this village.
career.townstead.tailor.description: Sews clothing at whatever sewing station the village has built, and keeps its people dressed for the season.
career.townstead.climatologist.descripti: Fetches supplies from the Fuel Store and Icehouse to keep village boilers and coolers stocked.
career.townstead.beverage_artisan.descri: A craftsperson of drinks, from everyday refreshments to specialist vintages.
career.townstead.cook.description: Turn everyday ingredients into nourishing meals and a lifetime at the stove into culinary mastery.
skill.townstead.cook.seasoned_hands.desc: Routine kitchen work has taught you how to waste less and recover faster. You gain 1 extra Cook XP whenever you complete work.
skill.townstead.cook.steady_simmer.descr: Patience keeps the pot from boiling over and the cook from burning out. You gain 1 extra Cook XP for each Cook rank you hold.
skill.townstead.cook.pizzaiolo.pizza_cra: Learn the foundations of dough, sauce, and heat that define a Pizzaiolo. You and allies within 5 blocks recover a little hunger.
skill.townstead.cook.pizzaiolo.starter_c: A living starter rewards anyone willing to tend it instead of rushing it. You gain 1 extra Cook XP whenever you complete work.
skill.townstead.cook.pizzaiolo.kitchen_r: Dough, peel, and oven settle into a practiced rhythm. You gain 1 extra Cook XP whenever you complete work.
skill.townstead.cook.pizzaiolo.pizza_spi: Turn a practiced flourish into breathing room when the kitchen gets crowded. You strike hostile creatures within 4 blocks and toss them into the air.
skill.townstead.cook.pizzaiolo.stone_ove: Read the oven by its heat, stone, and breath instead of by the clock. You gain 2 extra Cook XP whenever you complete work.
skill.townstead.cook.pizzaiolo.peel_vaul: A pizza peel is a lever when the floor gets too hot to trust. You vault forward and upward.
skill.townstead.cook.pizzaiolo.stone_hea: Hold a hard, even heat through a long service. You gain Fire Resistance, and hostile creatures around you catch fire.
skill.townstead.cook.pizzaiolo.blistered: The best crust carries the small scars of fierce heat and careful timing. You gain 2 extra Cook XP for each Cook rank you hold.
skill.townstead.cook.pizzaiolo.peel_swee: Clear the floor with the same broad motion that turns a pie. You sweep hostile creatures within 4 blocks with the peel.
skill.townstead.cook.pizzaiolo.stone_wis: Every oven has a temperament; you have learned how to listen. You gain 3 extra Cook XP for each Cook rank you hold.
career.townstead.scribe.description: The village's pen—keeping the Archives, printing the bulletin, and helping neighbors find their calling.
skill.townstead.scribe.steady_hand.descr: A clear hand keeps every name, tally, and promise fit to be read again. Near a lectern in the Archives, you recover energy every 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.scribe.long_ledger.descr: Good records reveal the shape of years, not merely the business of a day. In the Archives, you recover half a heart every 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.scribe.journalist.shorth: Every conversation is a chance to take notes. While talking with someone, you recover energy every 2 seconds.
skill.townstead.scribe.journalist.stakeo: The best stories happen after dark. In low light, you gain Night Vision.
skill.townstead.scribe.journalist.nose_f: Where there is danger, there is a story. While a hostile creature is within 16 blocks, you gain 3 Scoop every second.
skill.townstead.scribe.journalist.beat_r: Stories come to those who go looking. Outside the village border, you gain 2 Scoop every second.
skill.townstead.scribe.journalist.scoop_: A story this big keeps you going. With at least 75 Scoop, you recover half a heart and some energy every 2 seconds.
skill.townstead.scribe.journalist.eyewit: You saw it with your own eyes, and now everyone will. Hostile creatures within 12 blocks glow for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.scribe.journalist.fact_c: Get the facts straight and nothing can shake you. You gain Resistance for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.scribe.journalist.expose: Nothing stays hidden once it is in print. Hostile creatures within 24 blocks glow for 15 seconds.
skill.townstead.scribe.journalist.byline: Once your name is on the story, the guilty lose their nerve. Hostile creatures within 24 blocks glow and suffer Weakness for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.scribe.journalist.front_: The whole village reads the same headline. Hostile creatures within 48 blocks glow for 20 seconds.
skill.townstead.scribe.journalist.legwor: A reporter who waits misses the story. You gain Speed II for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.scribe.journalist.tip_of: A quick word in the right ear saves lives. When a hostile creature is within 16 blocks, you and allies within 10 blocks gain Speed for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.scribe.journalist.extra_: Breaking news gets everyone moving. You and allies within 10 blocks gain Speed and Resistance for 12 seconds.
skill.townstead.scribe.journalist.late_e: Good news, late at night, is still good news. When someone within 8 blocks is hurt, you and allies within 8 blocks gain Regeneration for 8 seconds.
skill.townstead.scribe.journalist.extra_: Read all about it! You and allies within 16 blocks gain Speed II and Resistance for 15 seconds.
skill.townstead.scribe.diplomat.courtesy: Good manners cost nothing and open every door. While talking with someone, you recover energy every 2 seconds.
skill.townstead.scribe.diplomat.safe_con: An envoy under a flag of truce is not a target. Illagers and other raiders ignore you.
skill.townstead.scribe.diplomat.common_g: Every friendly word adds to the trust between people. While talking with someone, or when someone likes you more, you gain 4 Goodwill every second.
skill.townstead.scribe.diplomat.accord.d: Trust keeps everyone safe. With at least 50 Goodwill, you and allies within 8 blocks gain Resistance every 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.scribe.diplomat.peacemak: Few want to fight someone everyone trusts. With at least 75 Goodwill, hostile creatures within 12 blocks suffer Weakness II every 2 seconds.
skill.townstead.scribe.diplomat.composur: A diplomat never lets them see you sweat. Below half health, you gain Regeneration.
skill.townstead.scribe.diplomat.olive_br: An open hand slows even an angry step. Hostile creatures within 8 blocks suffer Slowness for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.scribe.diplomat.parley.d: Talk first, fight never. Hostile creatures within 16 blocks suffer Weakness and Slowness for 12 seconds.
skill.townstead.scribe.diplomat.sanctuar: Some ground is agreed to be safe. You create a field for 15 seconds. Hostile creatures inside it suffer Weakness.
skill.townstead.scribe.diplomat.grand_ac: A treaty everyone signs. Hostile creatures within 16 blocks suffer Weakness and Slowness, and you create a field that keeps them weak for 15 seconds.
skill.townstead.scribe.diplomat.envoys_s: An envoy is always expected somewhere else. You gain Speed II for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.scribe.diplomat.open_doo: Everyone is welcome at your table. When someone within 8 blocks is hurt, you and allies within 8 blocks gain Regeneration for 8 seconds.
skill.townstead.scribe.diplomat.goodwill: A visit from a friend lifts everyone. You and allies within 10 blocks gain Regeneration and Resistance for 12 seconds.
skill.townstead.scribe.diplomat.envoys_f: A friend of the envoy is a friend of the village. Players within 8 blocks gain Hero of the Village for 1 minute.
skill.townstead.scribe.diplomat.treaty.d: Signed, sealed, and honored by all. Players within 16 blocks gain Hero of the Village II for 2 minutes, and allies within 8 blocks gain Resistance.
career.townstead.baker.description: A cook devoted to the oven, from daily bread to fine pastry.
skill.townstead.baker.early_riser.descri: The bread is in the oven before the rooster wakes. Around dawn, you recover energy every 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.baker.flour_toss.descrip: A handful of flour buys a moment to slip away. You raise a small flour cloud around you. Creatures lose sight of anyone inside it.
skill.townstead.baker.pastry_chef.piping: A steady hand finishes every cake with a flourish. In the bakery, you light candles and candle cakes within 6 blocks every 5 seconds.
skill.townstead.baker.pastry_chef.fine_c: A tidy kitchen is a quick kitchen. In the bakery, you and allies within 6 blocks gain Haste.
skill.townstead.baker.pastry_chef.sugar_: Sugar tells you when it is ready, if you watch it closely. In the bakery near a lit oven, you gain 3 Proof every second.
A little sweetness settles any stomach. With at least 50 Proof, Poison and Hunger are cleared from you and allies within 8 blocks every 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.baker.pastry_chef.patiss: When the whole shop is rising, so is everyone in it. With at least 75 Proof, you and allies within 8 blocks keep Speed and Haste.
skill.townstead.baker.pastry_chef.sugar_: One bite and you are off. You gain Speed and Jump Boost for 10 seconds.
A shake of sugar puts a spring in every step. You raise a cloud of sugar dust, and you and allies within 4 blocks gain Speed for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.baker.pastry_chef.candy_: Spun sugar is light enough to float away, and so is anyone caught in it. Hostile creatures within 8 blocks float up for 2 seconds.
skill.townstead.baker.pastry_chef.confec: A whole kitchen's worth of sugar in the air. You raise a large cloud of sugar dust for 15 seconds. Allies inside it gain Speed II.
skill.townstead.baker.pastry_chef.spun_s: The air turns to candy floss and everything hostile goes up with it. Hostile creatures within 16 blocks float up for 3 seconds.
Quick hands make light work. You gain Haste for 15 seconds.
skill.townstead.baker.pastry_chef.foldin: Fold in the air and everything lifts. You and allies within 6 blocks gain Jump Boost II for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.baker.pastry_chef.mering: Light as air, and so are you. You and allies within 8 blocks gain Slow Falling and Jump Boost II for 15 seconds.
skill.townstead.baker.pastry_chef.souffl: Everything that proofs well, rises. You launch yourself high into the air and drift down with Slow Falling.
skill.townstead.baker.pastry_chef.grand_: The last course lifts the whole room. You raise a cloud of sugar dust, and you and allies within 12 blocks gain Speed II and Haste II for 30 seconds.
skill.townstead.baker.jam_maker.clean_ja: Good jam starts with good fruit. In the village, one unripe sweet berry bush within 6 blocks ripens a stage every 30 seconds.
skill.townstead.baker.jam_maker.honey_ke: Bees work harder for a keeper they trust. In the village, one beehive within 6 blocks gains honey every 30 seconds.
skill.townstead.baker.jam_maker.slow_boi: Give fruit time to deepen without letting sweetness scorch. Near a lit pot, oven, or campfire, you gain 3 Proof every second.
skill.townstead.baker.jam_maker.pantry.d: A full pantry makes the orchard eager. With at least 50 Proof, one unripe sweet berry bush within 6 blocks ripens a stage every 20 seconds.
skill.townstead.baker.jam_maker.harvest_: Nothing in your care goes untended. In the village, every 20 seconds, one sweet berry bush and one beehive within 8 blocks gain a stage of fruit or honey.
skill.townstead.baker.jam_maker.jam_jar_: A broken jar makes a sticky floor. You spill jam under hostile creatures within 5 blocks. Anything in jam moves slowly.
skill.townstead.baker.jam_maker.setting_: Know the instant jam sets, and your enemies with it. You spill jam under hostile creatures within 10 blocks, and they suffer Slowness for 5 seconds.
skill.townstead.baker.jam_maker.preserve: A whole batch, spilled on purpose. You cover the ground within 4 blocks in jam and gain Speed II for 5 seconds to get clear.
skill.townstead.baker.jam_maker.marmalad: Nobody crosses a moat of marmalade quickly. You spill a square ring of jam 4 blocks out around you.
skill.townstead.baker.jam_maker.jam_sess: Every jar in the pantry, all at once. You spill jam under hostile creatures within 16 blocks, and they suffer Slowness II for 8 seconds.
skill.townstead.baker.jam_maker.hive_smo: A keeper's smoker calms the hive and hides the keeper. You raise a small cloud of smoke around you. Creatures lose sight of anyone inside it.
skill.townstead.baker.jam_maker.pollinat: Help the orchard along, one plant at a time. Crops and berry bushes within 3 blocks grow a stage.
skill.townstead.baker.jam_maker.bee_frie: The hives know your hands. Bees never attack you.
skill.townstead.baker.jam_maker.orchard_: The orchard answers when you ask. Crops and berry bushes within 5 blocks grow a stage, and beehives within 5 blocks gain honey.
skill.townstead.baker.jam_maker.bramble_: An old orchard defends itself. You raise a ring of thorns 3 blocks out around you for 20 seconds. The thorns slow and scratch hostile creatures, and let allies pass.
skill.townstead.baker.miller.millstone_s: Years of hauling sacks make you hard to move. You gain knockback resistance.
skill.townstead.baker.miller.vermin_keep: No mill tolerates pests. Silverfish, endermites, and spiders keep away from you.
skill.townstead.baker.miller.turning_sto: The stones set the rhythm and you keep it. Near a millstone or hay bales, you gain 3 Proof every second.
skill.townstead.baker.miller.threshing_f: The fields keep pace with the mill. With at least 50 Proof, one unripe wheat crop within 8 blocks grows a stage every 20 seconds.
skill.townstead.baker.miller.millers_str: Up and down the mill stairs all day long. You step up full blocks without jumping.
A split sack fills the air in an instant. You raise a flour cloud around you. Creatures lose sight of anyone inside it.
skill.townstead.baker.miller.flour_cloud: Where there is flour, there is cover. You raise a wide flour cloud around you.
The whole loft comes down at once. You raise a large flour cloud, and hostile creatures within 6 blocks suffer Blindness for 5 seconds.
skill.townstead.baker.miller.chaff.descr: A puff for everyone. You raise a flour cloud around you and each ally within 8 blocks.
skill.townstead.baker.miller.whiteout.de: Nobody sees anything. You raise a flour cloud that reaches 7 blocks around you.
skill.townstead.baker.miller.sails.descr: A turn of the sails sends anything flying. You push hostile creatures within 4 blocks away from you.
skill.townstead.baker.miller.grist.descr: Everything that grows ends up at the mill. Wheat within 3 blocks grows a stage.
skill.townstead.baker.miller.windmill.de: Full sail, full strength. You push hostile creatures within 8 blocks far away from you.
The wind takes your enemies and carries your friends. You push hostile creatures within 8 blocks away, and you and allies within 8 blocks gain Slow Falling for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.baker.miller.millrace.de: A storm through the mill yard. You push hostile creatures within 16 blocks away from you.
A day in the open air keeps you going. Outdoors in daylight, you recover energy every 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.farmer.field_hand.descri: Harvest waits for no one. You gain Speed and Haste for 15 seconds.
skill.townstead.farmer.levy.calloused_ha: Years at the hoe build a grip that hits hard. Attacks with a hoe deal 50% more damage.
skill.townstead.farmer.levy.hamstring.de: Cut low, like cutting wheat. Creatures you hit with a hoe suffer Slowness II for 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.farmer.levy.toil.descrip: Hard work is its own reward. With a hoe in hand and a hostile creature within 8 blocks, you gain 3 Grit every second.
skill.townstead.farmer.levy.hard_harvest: The dead should stay in the ground. At night, attacks with a hoe deal 50% more damage to undead creatures.
Every harvest pays out. Defeating a creature with a hoe restores 15 Grit.
skill.townstead.farmer.levy.reap.descrip: Swing low and wide. You strike hostile creatures in front of you within 4 blocks.
skill.townstead.farmer.levy.sweep_the_ro: Clear a row in one stroke. You strike hostile creatures in front of you within 5 blocks and knock them back.
skill.townstead.farmer.levy.threshing_bl: Beat the grain from the stalk. You deliver a heavy strike to hostile creatures directly in front of you, and they suffer Slowness IV for 5 seconds.
skill.townstead.farmer.levy.whirlwind.de: A full turn of the blade. You strike every hostile creature within 4 blocks and push them away.
The last harvest of the year. You strike every hostile creature within 7 blocks, and they suffer Wither II for 5 seconds.
skill.townstead.farmer.levy.rally.descri: A shout from the field and everyone stands taller. You and allies within 8 blocks gain Strength for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.farmer.levy.hold_the_lin: Shoulder to shoulder, nobody breaks. You and allies within 8 blocks gain Resistance for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.farmer.levy.call_to_arms: Every hand in the village picks up a tool. You and allies within 12 blocks gain Speed and Strength for 15 seconds.
The levy closes ranks. You and allies within 8 blocks gain Resistance II and Absorption for 15 seconds.
skill.townstead.farmer.levy.levee_en_mas: The whole village answers. You and every ally within 16 blocks gain Strength II and Resistance for 30 seconds.
skill.townstead.farmer.scarecrow.hide_in: Stand still in the crops and you are just another stalk. While standing still in crops or tall grass, you are invisible.
skill.townstead.farmer.scarecrow.straw_s: Nothing hurts when you are full of straw. You take no fall damage.
skill.townstead.farmer.scarecrow.watchfu: A scarecrow never blinks. While standing still outdoors, you gain 3 Grit every second.
skill.townstead.farmer.scarecrow.stand_s: Something about you makes them keep their distance. While you stand still, hostile creatures within 8 blocks avoid you.
skill.townstead.farmer.scarecrow.harvest: You are part of the landscape now. With at least 75 Grit, you are invisible whenever you stand still.
skill.townstead.farmer.scarecrow.boo.des: Nothing startles like a scarecrow that moves. You push back hostile creatures within 4 blocks, and they suffer Slowness for 3 seconds.
A shake of dry straw in the dark. You push away hostile creatures within 6 blocks and blind them for 2 seconds.
skill.townstead.farmer.scarecrow.dread.d: They know something is watching. Hostile creatures within 8 blocks suffer Weakness II and Slowness for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.farmer.scarecrow.nightma: The field goes dark around them. Hostile creatures within 10 blocks suffer Blindness, Darkness, and Slowness for 8 seconds.
skill.townstead.farmer.scarecrow.dread_h: Everything in the field runs. You drive hostile creatures within 16 blocks away from you, and they suffer Weakness II for 15 seconds.
skill.townstead.farmer.scarecrow.straw_d: Was that you, or the scarecrow? You become invisible for 5 seconds.
skill.townstead.farmer.scarecrow.chaff_i: A gust of chaff hides everything. You raise a cloud of straw around you. Creatures lose sight of anyone inside it.
skill.townstead.farmer.scarecrow.scarecr: Plant yourself and let them come. You gain Resistance II and push back hostile creatures within 6 blocks, but you move slowly for 10 seconds.
Gone into the chaff. You raise a cloud of straw and become invisible for 20 seconds.
skill.townstead.farmer.scarecrow.field_o: The whole field turns to chaff. You raise a cloud of straw that reaches 7 blocks around you.
skill.townstead.farmer.tiller.sure_footi: Nothing tangles a farmer's boots. Cobwebs, berry bushes, and powder snow no longer slow you.
Plant your feet in good soil and nothing moves you. While standing on dirt, grass, or farmland, you cannot be knocked back.
skill.townstead.farmer.tiller.worked_ear: The ground gives back what you put in. While standing on dirt, grass, or farmland, you gain 3 Grit every second.
skill.townstead.farmer.tiller.stomp.desc: Land hard and the ground answers. Landing from a fall sends out a shockwave that throws hostile creatures within 4 blocks into the air.
skill.townstead.farmer.tiller.bedrock_st: Like the stone under the soil. With at least 75 Grit, you gain Resistance while standing on dirt, grass, or farmland.
skill.townstead.farmer.tiller.tamp.descr: Pack the earth down hard. You bounce hostile creatures within 3 blocks into the air.
skill.townstead.farmer.tiller.furrow_lin: A shockwave straight down the row. You push hostile creatures in front of you within 7 blocks far away.
skill.townstead.farmer.tiller.churn.desc: Turn the ground to mud under their feet. You churn the ground within 3 blocks into mud that slows hostile creatures, and bounce them into the air.
skill.townstead.farmer.tiller.fault_line: The ground splits in a line. You push hostile creatures in front of you within 12 blocks away, and they suffer Slowness II for 5 seconds.
skill.townstead.farmer.tiller.earthquake: The whole field heaves. You throw back hostile creatures within 12 blocks and leave the ground within 5 blocks as mud.
skill.townstead.farmer.tiller.plow_ahead: Lean in and go. You dash forward.
skill.townstead.farmer.tiller.shoulder_c: Nothing stands in a plow's way. You dash forward and shove aside hostile creatures within 3 blocks.
Head down, like an ox in harness. You charge forward and knock back hostile creatures within 3 blocks, and they suffer Slowness for 5 seconds.
skill.townstead.farmer.tiller.uproot.des: Tear them out by the roots. You charge forward and throw hostile creatures within 4 blocks into the air.
A charge that brings the hillside with it. You charge forward and, a moment later, throw back hostile creatures within 8 blocks and leave the ground as mud.
skill.townstead.fisherman.patient_line.d: The fish come to those who wait. While standing still near water, you recover energy every 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.fisherman.sea_legs.descr: Born for the water. You gain Dolphin's Grace and Speed for 15 seconds.
skill.townstead.fisherman.harpooner.barb: A hook with a barb holds what it catches. Creatures you hit with a fishing rod take 2 extra damage and suffer Slowness for 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.fisherman.harpooner.haul: Arms built by hauling nets. You gain knockback resistance.
skill.townstead.fisherman.harpooner.taut: Feel the pull on the line. With a fishing rod in hand and a hostile creature within 8 blocks, you gain 3 Tide every second.
skill.townstead.fisherman.harpooner.fill: You know exactly where to cut. Attacks with a fishing rod deal 50% more damage to aquatic creatures.
skill.townstead.fisherman.harpooner.old_: A lifetime at sea has made you hard to beat. With at least 75 Tide and a fishing rod in hand, you gain Strength and Resistance.
skill.townstead.fisherman.harpooner.get_: Hook it and haul it in. You yank the creature you are aiming at, up to 12 blocks away, toward you.
skill.townstead.fisherman.harpooner.snag: Once it is hooked, it is not going anywhere. You yank the creature you are aiming at toward you, and it suffers Slowness III for 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.fisherman.harpooner.gaff: Haul it in and finish it at the rail. You yank the creature you are aiming at toward you and strike it hard.
skill.townstead.fisherman.harpooner.traw: Drag the whole school in. You yank every hostile creature in front of you within 12 blocks toward you.
skill.townstead.fisherman.harpooner.levi: A line strong enough for anything in the sea. You yank every hostile creature within 16 blocks toward you, strike them, and they suffer Slowness II for 5 seconds.
skill.townstead.fisherman.harpooner.cast: Cast the line and follow it. You fling yourself forward and up.
skill.townstead.fisherman.harpooner.life: Throw a line to someone in trouble. You pull the ally you are aiming at, up to 12 blocks away, to safety, and they gain Resistance for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.fisherman.harpooner.teth: Tie it off and it stays put. The creature you are aiming at suffers Slowness V for 8 seconds.
skill.townstead.fisherman.harpooner.man_: Everyone back on deck! You pull every ally within 12 blocks toward you, and they gain Resistance for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.fisherman.harpooner.hook: It swallowed the whole thing. You yank the creature you are aiming at toward you, and it suffers Slowness V and Weakness II for 8 seconds.
skill.townstead.fisherman.tidecaller.web: You swim like you were born to it. In water, you gain Dolphin's Grace.
skill.townstead.fisherman.tidecaller.dee: One breath lasts a long dive. You can breathe underwater.
skill.townstead.fisherman.tidecaller.swe: The sea fills you up. While in water, you gain 3 Tide every second.
skill.townstead.fisherman.tidecaller.sal: The ocean looks after its own. In water, you gain Conduit Power.
skill.townstead.fisherman.tidecaller.wal: The sea holds you up. With at least 75 Tide, you can walk on water. Sneak to sink.
skill.townstead.fisherman.tidecaller.spl: A wall of spray. You push hostile creatures within 4 blocks away and put out burning allies within 6 blocks.
skill.townstead.fisherman.tidecaller.und: The current takes them down. You drag hostile creatures in water within 8 blocks under, and they suffer Slowness for 5 seconds.
skill.townstead.fisherman.tidecaller.whi: The water turns and everything goes with it. You pull hostile creatures within 8 blocks toward you, and they suffer Slowness II for 5 seconds.
skill.townstead.fisherman.tidecaller.rip: Ride the current like a spear. You launch yourself forward and strike hostile creatures near you.
skill.townstead.fisherman.tidecaller.mae: The sea opens up. You pull hostile creatures within 16 blocks toward you, drag them down, and they suffer Slowness II for 8 seconds.
skill.townstead.fisherman.tidecaller.fre: A cool drink and a dunk. You put out burning allies within 8 blocks, and they gain Water Breathing for 30 seconds.
skill.townstead.fisherman.tidecaller.tid: The water shields its friends. You and allies within 8 blocks who are in water gain Resistance for 15 seconds.
skill.townstead.fisherman.tidecaller.dol: Swim with the pod. You and allies within 10 blocks gain Dolphin's Grace and Speed for 20 seconds.
skill.townstead.fisherman.tidecaller.sea: Heave ho, and the work goes faster. You and allies within 10 blocks gain Haste and Strength for 30 seconds.
skill.townstead.fisherman.tidecaller.con: Carry the heart of the sea to your friends. You and allies within 12 blocks gain Conduit Power for 60 seconds.
skill.townstead.fisherman.netter.knot_wo: You know every knot, so none of them hold you. Cobwebs and berry bushes never slow you.
Every cast snarls something. Creatures you hit with a fishing rod suffer Slowness II for 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.fisherman.netter.full_ne: A heavy net is a good day. While a slowed hostile creature is within 8 blocks, you gain 3 Tide every second.
skill.townstead.fisherman.netter.strong_: Your own nets are where you stand firmest. While standing in a net, mud, or other haze, you gain Resistance.
skill.townstead.fisherman.netter.master_: Nothing escapes your reach. With at least 75 Tide, hostile creatures within 6 blocks stay slowed.
skill.townstead.fisherman.netter.toss_ne: One throw, and they are caught. You throw nets under hostile creatures within 5 blocks. Nets heavily slow hostile creatures.
skill.townstead.fisherman.netter.drag_ne: Sweep the net across the whole row. You throw nets under hostile creatures in front of you within 8 blocks.
skill.townstead.fisherman.netter.seine.d: A net all the way around. You lay nets on the ground within 4 blocks of you.
skill.townstead.fisherman.netter.trawl_n: Drag the whole bay. You throw nets under every hostile creature within 12 blocks.
skill.townstead.fisherman.netter.great_n: The net that catches everything. You lay nets within 6 blocks of you, and every hostile creature within 16 blocks suffers Slowness II for 8 seconds.
skill.townstead.fisherman.netter.lure.de: Wave the bait and they come to you instead. Hostile creatures within 8 blocks attack you.
skill.townstead.fisherman.netter.bait_an: Draw them in, then vanish. Hostile creatures within 8 blocks attack you, then you become invisible for 5 seconds.
skill.townstead.fisherman.netter.chum.de: Blood in the water. You pull hostile creatures within 12 blocks toward you, and they attack you.
skill.townstead.fisherman.netter.iron_gu: Let them come. Hostile creatures within 10 blocks attack you, and you gain Resistance II for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.fisherman.netter.the_big: The catch of a lifetime, and it is angry. You pull every hostile creature within 16 blocks toward you, and they suffer Slowness IV. You gain Resistance III for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.beverage_artisan.taste_t: Every drink is a chance to check the batch. When you finish a drink, you gain Speed for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.beverage_artisan.hospita: A drink and a seat for anyone who needs one. You and allies within 6 blocks recover energy.
skill.townstead.beverage_artisan.barista: Morning Cup
The first cup of the day. Around dawn, you gain 2 Buzz every second.
Steady Hands
Enough coffee to work fast, not enough to shake. With at least 50 Buzz, you gain Haste.
Crema
The sweet spot, right on top. While your Buzz is between 34 and 66, you gain Speed and Jump Boost.
Caffeinated
Wired and ready. With at least 67 Buzz, you gain Strength.
Perfect Pour
When the pour is perfect, everyone feels it. While your Buzz is between 34 and 66, allies within 6 blocks gain Speed and Haste.
Espresso Shot
Short, strong, and straight to the head. You gain Speed for 10 seconds and 20 Buzz. The more Buzz you already have, the stronger the Speed. At 100 Buzz you crash.
Double Shot
Twice the kick. You and allies within 4 blocks gain Speed and Haste for 10 seconds, and you gain 35 Buzz. The more Buzz you already have, the stronger the effect.
Cold Brew
Slow to make, smooth to drink. You and allies within 8 blocks gain Haste for 20 seconds, and you gain 25 Buzz. The more Buzz you already have, the stronger the Haste.
Rush Hour
Every order at once, and nobody waits. You and allies within 10 blocks gain Speed II and Haste II for 15 seconds, and you gain 30 Buzz. Above 67 Buzz, they also gain Strength.
Rocket Fuel
Not recommended. You gain Speed III, Jump Boost II, and Haste III for 15 seconds and 40 Buzz. It almost always ends in a crash.
Settle the Kettle
A deliberate pause over a cup makes everyone harder to rattle. You and allies within 5 blocks gain Resistance and Slowness for 10 seconds, and you lose 20 Buzz.
Jitters
Pass the shakes on to someone else. Hostile creatures within 6 blocks suffer Slowness II and Weakness for 8 seconds.
Decaf
Sometimes you need to come down gently. Your Buzz drops to 0, and you gain Resistance for 10 seconds.
Spilled Coffee
Hot, and all over the floor. You spill scalding coffee under hostile creatures within 8 blocks. It burns and slows them.
Last Drop
Every last bit of the pot. Hostile creatures within 12 blocks suffer Slowness III and Weakness II, and you and allies gain Speed II for 15 seconds.
skill.townstead.beverage_artisan.bartend: Familiar Faces
You never forget a face. Anyone who spends about a minute near you becomes one of your regulars.
Bar Stool
Pull up a seat. Your regulars within 8 blocks recover energy every 5 seconds.
Running Tab
Busy bar, full tab. While at least 2 allies are within 6 blocks, you gain 3 Tab every second.
Heavy Hand
A bartender who can throw a punch. Your hits knock creatures far back.
Everybody Knows Your Name
Where everybody is glad you came. With at least 75 Tab, your regulars within 24 blocks keep Resistance and Speed.
Clear the Air
A calm word settles the whole room. Nausea is cleared from guests within 6 blocks. It does not sober anyone up or excuse another drink.
Eighty-Six
You're done here. You throw the creature you are aiming at, up to 8 blocks away, somewhere up to 12 blocks off.
Bum's Rush
Out, all of you. You throw hostile creatures within 5 blocks somewhere up to 10 blocks off.
Closing Time
You don't have to go home, but you can't stay here. You throw hostile creatures within 10 blocks up to 16 blocks off, and they suffer Slowness for 5 seconds.
Last Call
Last call, and the bar empties. You throw every hostile creature within 16 blocks up to 24 blocks off.
On the House
The bartender's special, and nobody knows what's in it. You and allies within 6 blocks gain a random drink effect for 20 seconds.
Round for the Regulars
This one's for the regulars. Your regulars within 24 blocks gain Speed and Haste for 30 seconds.
House Special
The good stuff from under the bar. You and allies within 8 blocks gain a strong random drink effect for 30 seconds.
Toast
Raise a glass to the regulars. Your regulars within 32 blocks gain Strength and Resistance for 30 seconds.
Bottle Service
Everyone gets their own bottle. Each of your regulars within 32 blocks gains their own strong random drink effect for 60 seconds.
Cool Head
A brewer holds their drink. You are immune to Nausea.
Iron Liver
Nothing you drink can hurt you. You are immune to Poison.
Patient Fermentation
Learn when a living batch needs intervention, and when the finest tool in the cellar is time. Near a barrel or brewing stand, you gain 3 Ferment every second.
Aged in Oak
Time makes everything stronger. With at least 50 Ferment, you gain Strength.
Vintage
A rare year, shared with friends. With at least 75 Ferment, you and allies within 8 blocks keep Resistance and Fire Resistance.
Tap the Keg
Open the tap and let it flow. You spill ale under hostile creatures within 4 blocks. Anything standing in ale staggers and cannot walk straight.
Barrel Roll
Roll out the barrel. You charge forward, knocking back hostile creatures within 3 blocks and spilling ale under them.
Froth
Too much head on this one. You spill ale within 3 blocks, and hostile creatures within 6 blocks stagger.
Pub Brawl
Somebody spilled somebody's drink. You spill ale under every hostile creature within 10 blocks, and they suffer Weakness for 10 seconds.
Flood the Cellar
Every cask at once. You flood the ground within 6 blocks with ale and spill it under every hostile creature within 16 blocks.
Slow Brew
Good things take time. You and allies within 6 blocks gain Resistance for 5 seconds. 10 seconds later, once it has brewed, they gain Strength for 30 seconds.
Second Pour
The second glass is always better. You and allies within 6 blocks gain Speed for 5 seconds. 10 seconds later, they gain Haste II for 30 seconds.
Cask Strength
Straight from the cask, after a moment to breathe. 5 seconds after you pour it, you and allies within 8 blocks gain Strength II and Resistance for 30 seconds.
Sour Mash
A bad batch does its work slowly. Hostile creatures within 8 blocks suffer Weakness now. 10 seconds later, once it turns, they suffer Poison II and Slowness II for 8 seconds.
Grand Cru
The finest vintage you will ever pour. You and allies within 12 blocks gain Resistance now. 10 seconds later, they gain Strength II, Speed II, and Resistance II for 60 seconds.
skill.townstead.beverage_artisan.winemak: Vine Walker
You walk the rows without a snag. Cobwebs and berry bushes never slow you.
Sun-Kissed
The sun ripens you too. In full sun, you gain Speed.
Aeration
Let it breathe. Near a fermentation barrel or barrel, you gain 3 Vintage every second.
Bouquet
Every note, every scent. With at least 50 Vintage, you gain Night Vision, and hostile creatures within 24 blocks glow.
Estate
The finest vineyard in the land. With at least 75 Vintage, you and allies within 10 blocks in full sun gain Resistance and Haste.
Grape Stomp
Stomp, stomp, stomp. You bounce hostile creatures within 3 blocks, and they suffer Slowness for 5 seconds.
Crush
Into the vat with you. You strike hostile creatures within 4 blocks, and they suffer Slowness II for 5 seconds.
Vine Snare
The vines reach out. You grow tangling vines under hostile creatures within 6 blocks.
Trellis Ring
A vineyard fence. You grow a ring of tangling vines 3 blocks out around you.
Harvest Stomp
The whole village stomps. You throw hostile creatures within 8 blocks into the air, strike them, and grow vines around you.
Pairing
The right glass for the hour. You gain an effect for 30 seconds that depends on the time: Haste in the morning, Strength in the afternoon, Speed in the evening, and Night Vision at night.
Wine Flight
Something for everyone. You and allies within 6 blocks gain the pairing for the hour for 30 seconds.
Decant
It opens up with a moment in the glass. 5 seconds after you pour, you and allies within 8 blocks gain Strength II for 30 seconds.
Cellar Selection
From the private cellar. You and allies within 10 blocks gain a stronger pairing and Resistance for 60 seconds.
Vertical Tasting
Every year of the same wine, in order. You and allies within 12 blocks gain Resistance now. 10 seconds later, they gain Strength II and Speed II for 60 seconds.
skill.townstead.beverage_artisan.sandy_m: Sun Lover
Nothing beats a sunny day. In full sun, you gain Speed.
Sea Breeze
A cool breeze off the water. Heat no longer affects your body temperature.
Happy Hour
Two for one at the palm bar. Near a palm bar, you gain 3 Tan every second.
Sunscreen
Reapply every two hours. With at least 50 Tan, in full sun, you gain Fire Resistance.
Endless Summer
It never has to end. With at least 75 Tan, you and allies within 10 blocks gain Speed and Resistance.
Mocktail
All of the fun, none of the headache. You gain a random refreshing effect for 20 seconds.
Tropical Punch
A bowl for the whole beach. You and allies within 6 blocks each gain a random refreshing effect for 30 seconds.
Frozen Daiquiri
Brain freeze! You chill hostile creatures within 6 blocks, and they suffer Slowness II for 6 seconds.
Coconut Bomb
Heads up! The creature you are aiming at, up to 16 blocks away, is bonked and suffers Nausea for 8 seconds.
Signature Cocktail
The house special, with a little umbrella. You and allies within 14 blocks each gain a strong random effect for 60 seconds.
Beach Ball
Incoming! You bounce hostile creatures within 5 blocks up and away from you.
Limbo
How low can you go? You and allies within 6 blocks gain Jump Boost II and Speed for 20 seconds.
Luau
Grass skirts and good company. You and allies within 10 blocks gain Haste and Strength for 30 seconds.
Conga Line
Everybody conga! Allies within 10 blocks gain Speed II for 20 seconds and are pulled into line behind you.
Beach Party
The party of the summer. Hostile creatures within 14 blocks suffer Nausea, and you and allies gain Strength II for 30 seconds.

skill.townstead.cleric.pilgrim.pilgrimag: The long walk, made light. You and allies within 16 blocks gain Speed II for 60 seconds and fully recover thirst and energy.
skill.townstead.cleric.pilgrim.night_wal: The road does not end at sundown. You gain Night Vision for 60 seconds.
skill.townstead.cleric.pilgrim.safe_pass: Let the pilgrim pass. Hostile creatures within 8 blocks suffer Weakness for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.cleric.pilgrim.shelter.d: A roof in any storm. You and allies within 8 blocks gain Resistance and Fire Resistance for 20 seconds.
skill.townstead.cleric.pilgrim.lantern.d: A light the darkness fears. You blind hostile creatures within 10 blocks for 5 seconds, and you and allies gain Night Vision for 60 seconds.
skill.townstead.cleric.pilgrim.guiding_l: Follow the light home. You and allies within 16 blocks gain Speed II, Night Vision, and Resistance for 60 seconds.
skill.townstead.cartographer.well_travel: Your feet know the way. Outside the village, you gain Speed.
skill.townstead.cartographer.compass_ros: Pick a direction and go. You gain Speed and Jump Boost for 15 seconds.
Sure Stride
Nothing on the trail trips you up. Cobwebs, berry bushes, and powder snow no longer slow you.
Trail Legs
Rough ground is just ground. You can step up full blocks without jumping.
Mile Marker
Every mile counts. While travelling outside the village, you gain 3 Bearing every second.
Second Wind
The road gives you strength. With at least 50 Bearing, you recover energy every 3 seconds.
Homing
You always know the way back. With at least 75 Bearing, you gain Speed II.
Mark Waypoint
Mark it on the map. You set your waypoint where you stand. You can hold one waypoint at a time.
Return
Back the way you came. You return to your waypoint. Long cooldown.
Swift Return
You have walked it so often. You return to your waypoint.
Escape Route
Always know the way out. You return to your waypoint and become invisible for 10 seconds.
Homeward
Home at last. You return to your waypoint and gain Resistance II and Speed II for 20 seconds.
Keen Sight
Eyes adjusted to any light. You gain Night Vision for 60 seconds.
Scout Ahead
Go and see. You dash forward.
Trail Markers
Follow my marks. You and allies within 10 blocks gain Speed for 30 seconds.
Forced March
No stopping until nightfall. You and allies within 10 blocks gain Speed II for 30 seconds and recover energy.
Expedition
Into the unknown, together. You and allies within 16 blocks gain Speed II, Resistance, and Night Vision for 60 seconds.
Ore Sense
You can feel the metal in the rock. Ores within 6 blocks glint every 5 seconds.
Miner's Eyes
Your eyes know the dark. Underground, you gain Night Vision.
Strike It Rich
Deeper is richer. Underground, you gain 3 Bearing every second.
Vein Sense
You feel the whole vein now. With at least 50 Bearing, ores within 10 blocks glint every 5 seconds.
Motherlode
The mountain gives up its secrets. With at least 75 Bearing, you gain Haste II underground.
Tap the Rock
Listen to the stone. Ores within 6 blocks glint.
Echo Sound
The echo tells you what is behind the wall. Ores within 8 blocks glint.
Assay
Know the rock before you break it. Ores within 10 blocks glint, and you gain Night Vision for 60 seconds.
Deep Survey
Map the whole seam. Ores within 12 blocks glint, and you gain Haste for 60 seconds.
Eureka
There it is! Ores within 12 blocks glint, and you gain Haste III and Night Vision for 60 seconds.
Miner's Lamp
A lamp on your hat. You gain Night Vision for 60 seconds.
Shore Up
Brace the tunnel. You and allies within 6 blocks gain Resistance for 20 seconds.
Flare

Deep Delver
Built for the deep places. You gain Haste II and Resistance for 30 seconds.
Gold Rush
Everyone digs! You and allies within 10 blocks gain Haste II, Speed, and Night Vision for 60 seconds.

skill.townstead.cartographer.surveyor.cl: Thin air, clear head. High up, you gain Speed.

skill.townstead.cartographer.surveyor.gr: Map every threat in the valley. Hostile creatures within 32 blocks glow for 20 seconds, and you and allies gain Speed.

skill.townstead.tailor.clothier.winter_c: Wrapped warm. Cold affects your body 70% less.
skill.townstead.tailor.clothier.summer_l: Light and cool. Heat affects your body 70% less.
Hold still, I'm measuring. With at least 2 allies within 6 blocks, you gain 3 Stitch every second.
skill.townstead.tailor.clothier.dressed_: Everyone walks taller. With at least 50 Stitch, allies within 8 blocks gain Speed.
skill.townstead.tailor.clothier.haute_co: The finest dressed in the land. With at least 75 Stitch, you and allies within 10 blocks gain Resistance and Speed.
skill.townstead.tailor.clothier.disguise: Nobody looks twice at a zombie. You put on a mob-head disguise for 10 seconds. While disguised, hostile creatures ignore you.
skill.townstead.tailor.clothier.quick_ch: A new face in a blink. You put on a mob-head disguise and gain Speed for 15 seconds.
skill.townstead.tailor.clothier.masquera: Everyone in masks. You put on a mob-head disguise for 20 seconds, and allies within 8 blocks gain Speed.
skill.townstead.tailor.clothier.master_o: Who? You put on a mob-head disguise for 40 seconds.
skill.townstead.tailor.clothier.grand_ma: The ball of the year. You put on a dragon-head disguise for 60 seconds, and allies within 12 blocks become invisible for 20 seconds.
skill.townstead.tailor.clothier.cloak.de: Wrap up. You and allies within 6 blocks gain Resistance for 15 seconds.
skill.townstead.tailor.clothier.fine_boo: Good shoes make all the difference. You and allies within 8 blocks gain Speed for 30 seconds.
skill.townstead.tailor.clothier.tailored: Clothes that move with you. You and allies within 8 blocks gain Haste and Speed for 60 seconds.
skill.townstead.tailor.clothier.wardrobe: Something for every occasion. You and allies within 10 blocks gain Resistance and Fire Resistance for 60 seconds.
skill.townstead.tailor.clothier.royal_wa: Dressed like royalty. You and allies within 16 blocks gain Resistance II, Speed II, and Haste for 2 minutes.
skill.townstead.witch.iron_stomach.descr: A witch tastes everything once. You are immune to Poison.
skill.townstead.witch.cackle.description: Hee hee hee! Hostile creatures within 6 blocks suffer Weakness for 8 seconds.
skill.townstead.witch.hexer.evil_eye.des: Strike a witch and regret it. Whatever hurts you is hexed for a minute.
skill.townstead.witch.hexer.lingering_cu: The hex never lets go. Creatures you have hexed within 16 blocks are slowed every 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.witch.hexer.malice.descr: Every hex feeds you. While any creature is hexed, you gain 3 Hex every second.
skill.townstead.witch.hexer.withering_he: The hex rots them. With at least 50 Hex, creatures you have hexed within 16 blocks suffer Wither every 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.witch.hexer.doom.descrip: Their fate is sealed. With at least 75 Hex, creatures you have hexed within 24 blocks glow and suffer Weakness II.
skill.townstead.witch.hexer.hex.descript: Point and curse. You hex the creature you are aiming at for a minute, and it suffers Weakness for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.witch.hexer.jinx.descrip: Nothing goes right for them. You hex the creature you are aiming at, and it suffers Slowness II and Nausea for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.witch.hexer.mass_hex.des: Curses for everyone. You hex every hostile creature within 8 blocks.
skill.townstead.witch.hexer.curse_of_fra: Brittle bones. You hex every hostile creature within 12 blocks, and they suffer Weakness II for 15 seconds.
skill.townstead.witch.hexer.covens_curse: The whole coven curses them. You hex every hostile creature within 16 blocks, and they suffer Wither for 5 seconds.
skill.townstead.witch.hexer.twinge.descr: Feel that? You strike every creature you have hexed within 24 blocks.
skill.townstead.witch.hexer.hobble.descr: Your legs won't listen. Every creature you have hexed within 24 blocks suffers Slowness IV for 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.witch.hexer.blight.descr: Rot from within. You strike every creature you have hexed within 24 blocks, and they suffer Wither for 6 seconds.
skill.townstead.witch.hexer.hexblast.des: The curse bursts. You strike every creature you have hexed within 24 blocks hard and throw them back.
skill.townstead.witch.hexer.reckoning.de: Every curse comes due. You strike every creature you have hexed within 32 blocks for heavy damage, and they suffer Weakness III.
skill.townstead.witch.herbalist.poultice: Always carry a poultice. When you drop below 30% health, you gain Absorption II for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.witch.herbalist.antidote: You know every cure. You are immune to Wither and Nausea.
skill.townstead.witch.herbalist.gather_h: The garden gives. Near flowers or leaves, you gain 3 Hex every second.
skill.townstead.witch.herbalist.herbal_a: A sweet smell of herbs. With at least 50 Hex, Poison is cleared from you and allies within 8 blocks every 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.witch.herbalist.wise_wom: The village comes to you for everything. With at least 75 Hex, you and allies within 10 blocks gain Resistance.
skill.townstead.witch.herbalist.tonic.de: A bitter pick-me-up. You and allies within 4 blocks gain Speed and Haste for 20 seconds.
skill.townstead.witch.herbalist.salve.de: Rub it in. You and allies within 6 blocks gain Absorption for 30 seconds.
skill.townstead.witch.herbalist.cure_all: Good for what ails you. You clear harmful effects from you and allies within 10 blocks.
skill.townstead.witch.herbalist.elixir.d: The good bottle. You and allies within 10 blocks gain Resistance and Strength for 60 seconds.
The cure for everything. You clear harmful effects from you and allies within 16 blocks, and they gain Absorption II and Resistance II.
skill.townstead.witch.herbalist.nettle_s: A handful of nettles. Hostile creatures within 4 blocks suffer Poison for 5 seconds.
skill.townstead.witch.herbalist.toxic_cl: Don't breathe that. You raise a cloud of miasma around you. Miasma poisons hostile creatures inside it.
skill.townstead.witch.herbalist.nightsha: A deadly berry. The creature you are aiming at suffers Poison II and Weakness for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.witch.herbalist.miasma.d: A foul fog. You raise a wide cloud of miasma.
skill.townstead.witch.herbalist.plague_g: Nothing grows here but death. You raise a great cloud of miasma, and hostile creatures within 14 blocks suffer Poison II and Wither.
skill.townstead.witch.broomrider.light_a: Witches float. You take half damage from falling.
skill.townstead.witch.broomrider.night_f: Eyes for the night sky. At night, you gain Night Vision.
skill.townstead.witch.broomrider.moonlig: The moon charges you. Outdoors at night, you gain 3 Hex every second.
skill.townstead.witch.broomrider.broomst: Up, up, and away! You can fly freely while you have Hex. Flying drains Hex; when it runs out, the broom sets you down gently.
skill.townstead.witch.broomrider.sky_wit: The fastest broom in the coven. With at least 75 Hex, you fly 50% faster.
skill.townstead.witch.broomrider.take_of: Away we go! You leap high into the air and fall slowly for 5 seconds.
skill.townstead.witch.broomrider.swoop.d: Down and through. You swoop forward and fall slowly for 5 seconds.
skill.townstead.witch.broomrider.hex_bol: A curse from above. You strike the creature you are aiming at, up to 24 blocks away, and it suffers Weakness II for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.witch.broomrider.moon_di: Straight down on them. You throw hostile creatures within 5 blocks into the air and strike them.
skill.townstead.witch.broomrider.wild_hu: Ride with the coven. You and allies within 12 blocks gain Slow Falling, Speed II, and Night Vision for 60 seconds.
skill.townstead.witch.broomrider.black_c: Now you see me. You become invisible for 6 seconds.
skill.townstead.witch.broomrider.moonlit: The night hides its own. You and allies within 8 blocks gain Night Vision and Invisibility for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.witch.broomrider.nightma: A shadow across the moon. Hostile creatures within 10 blocks suffer Blindness and Darkness for 8 seconds.
skill.townstead.witch.broomrider.witchin: Midnight belongs to witches. Hostile creatures within 12 blocks suffer Weakness II and Slowness II for 15 seconds.
skill.townstead.witch.broomrider.coven_n: The whole coven flies tonight. You and allies within 16 blocks gain Night Vision, Speed II, and Invisibility for 30 seconds.
career.townstead.witch.description: A village herbalist and potion compounder who keeps exact remedies, volatile mixtures, and their consequences in careful custody.
skill.townstead.cook.chef.appetizer_menu: A good appetizer opens the appetite and leaves everyone wanting more. You and allies within 6 blocks gain Strength for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.cook.chef.chef_de_cuisin: A busy kitchen does not overwhelm you. With at least 75 Flow in a kitchen, you recover half a heart and 4 stamina every 2 seconds.
skill.townstead.cook.chef.chefs_knife.de: A practiced hand makes quick work of anything on the chopping block. With a kitchen knife equipped, hostile creatures in front of you take 6 damage.
skill.townstead.cook.chef.dessert_menu.d: A sweet finish wraps the meal perfectly. You and allies within 7 blocks gain Speed and Haste for 11 seconds.
skill.townstead.cook.chef.dinner_rush.de: When every order arrives at once, there is no time for hesitation. With a kitchen weapon equipped, you gain Strength II, Speed II, and Haste II for 8 seconds.
skill.townstead.cook.chef.flambe.descrip: Control the flame, and the spectacle takes care of itself. Hostile creatures in front of you take 4 damage and catch fire for 5 seconds.
A perfect ballroom dance of culinary mastery. You and allies within 9 blocks gain Strength, Resistance, and Speed for 12 seconds, and Regeneration for 6 seconds.
skill.townstead.cook.chef.kitchen_flow.d: Once you hit that flow state, it all becomes a well-executed dance. Near a lit heat source in a kitchen, you gain 3 Flow every second.
skill.townstead.cook.chef.kitchen_pace.d: In the heat and stress of the kitchen, you thrive. Near a lit heat source in a kitchen, you recover half a heart every 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.cook.chef.main_course.de: A substantial meal just anchors the whole thing. You and allies within 7 blocks gain Resistance and Absorption for 12 seconds.
When everything has its place, you are already ahead of the next order. In a kitchen with storage within 8 blocks, you recover 3 stamina every 2 seconds.
One clean cut in the right place is worth a dozen hurried blows. With a kitchen knife equipped, hostile creatures in a narrow arc take 9 damage and suffer Weakness for 5 seconds.
skill.townstead.cook.chef.running_the_pa: You keep an eye on every station and know when each plate is ready to leave. In a kitchen with another Cook within 8 blocks, you gain 4 Flow every 2 seconds.
skill.townstead.cook.chef.saute_toss.des: A sharp turn of the wrist keeps everything moving. With a skillet equipped, hostile creatures in a wide arc take 5 damage and are launched.
skill.townstead.cook.chef.soup_course.de: A warm first course settles the nerves and puts strength back into hungry diners. You and allies within 6 blocks gain Regeneration for 8 seconds.
townstead_voice.mca.crabby.dialogue.chat: How am I supposed to fish with nothing, exactly?
Someone's taken my rod, haven't they. Hand one over.
Barrel's full. Should've thought of that, shouldn't we.
Fish everywhere, nowhere to put them. Planning, it's called planning.
Another chest. Today, preferably. I've had enough.
A fisherman with no water. What are we, a comedy?
You expect me to fish in the dirt? Find me a pond already.
Path's blocked. Who leaves things in the way like this?
I can't reach the water because someone couldn't be bothered to clean up.
Move whatever it is out of my way. Honestly.
townstead_voice.mca.flirty.dialogue.chat: Oh sweetheart, got a rod I could borrow? I promise I'll make it worth your while.
A girl needs her tackle, darling. Help a pretty thing out?
Come closer, love. I'd fish if I had a rod — know anyone who could lend me one?
My barrel's stuffed, darling, and not in the fun way.
Sweetie, I need somewhere to put my catch. Got room for me?
Cozy up a chest for me, love, my barrel's full to the brim.
Honey, all this talk of getting wet and not a drop of water in sight.
Sugar, I need water like you need sweet company. Help me out?
Find me a nice pond, handsome, and I'll do the rest.
Sugar, something's in my way and you know how I hate being stood up.
Darling, the path to my spot's a mess. Clear it for me?
Come sweep me a path, handsome, and I'll sweep you off your feet.
townstead_voice.mca.gloomy.dialogue.chat: No rod. Of course. Why would there be.
Empty hands, empty pack. Fitting, really.
A rod would help. Not that anyone's listening.
No room for the catch. No room for me, either, it seems.
The barrel rejects me. Even wood turns its back.
Everything's full except my heart. Another chest would help.
No water anywhere. Just like the warmth of friendship.
The pond's gone dry, or never was. Hard to say which is worse.
I need water. But I'll probably just stand here.
The path is blocked. Maybe it's a sign.
I can't reach the water. I can't reach much of anything, really.
Something's in the way. Feels fitting.
townstead_voice.mca.greedy.dialogue.chat: No rod, no fish, no profit. Fix it.
A rod is a tool. Tools make coin. Bring me one.
You want fish? Rods don't grow on trees. Well, technically...
Barrel's full. That's a good problem. Give me another.
Storage overflowing. More chests means more inventory means more profit.
Expand the operation. I need another container, now.
No water means no fish means no revenue. Unacceptable.
Dig me a pond, close by. Time is emeralds.
I need water. Preferably before my competitors get any.
Blocked path. That's lost revenue right there.
Can't reach the water, can't move product. Unacceptable.
Clear the way. Every minute I'm here costs us both.
townstead_voice.mca.odd.dialogue.chat.fi: The rod has gone. Perhaps it swam away.
No rod. The fish are relieved, I suspect.
A rod, a rod, my kingdom for a rod. Or half a rod. I'm flexible.
The barrel refuses further fish. It is a barrel with standards.
Too many fish, not enough box. A tale as old as time.
Another container, please. The fish have opinions about crowding.
The water has gone elsewhere. Perhaps a party.
Where there is no water, there are no fish. A profound insight.
I dreamed of a pond. Woke up. Still no pond. Please find one.
An invisible wall. Or a real one. Either way, unfortunate.
The path is a riddle today, and I do not have the answer.
Something blocks the way. Perhaps it is me. Perhaps it is geometry.
townstead_voice.mca.playful.dialogue.cha: Hey hey, no rod! Wanna go find me one? I'll do a little jig.
Psst — I'm rod-less over here! Rescue me?
No rod, no fish, no fun. Help a pal out!
Barrel's burstin'! Gonna start stuffing fish in my pockets.
I need another chest or these fish are going rogue!
Room for one more? Or ten more? Please?
Oh no, dry land as far as I can see! Pond, please?
Fish can't fly, last I checked. Got any water around?
Gimme a puddle, a pond, a bathtub — anything wet!
Road closed ahead! Send a hero to clear the way!
Something's blockin' the path. Tag, you're it!
Can't get to the water — obstacle course got me good.
townstead_voice.mca.relaxed.dialogue.cha: No rod on me. No worries, whenever you've got one.
Could use a rod. Take your time, I'll be here.
A rod would be nice. Plenty of time, friend.
Barrel's full. A spare chest anywhere around? No pressure.
My catch needs a home. I'll hold onto it 'til you sort one.
Whenever you get a moment, we could use another container.
No water to cast in. I'll wait 'til one turns up.
Point me at a pond, I'll take it from there. No rush.
Any water nearby? I'll just enjoy the quiet until you find one.
Path's a bit tricky today. Sort it when you can.
Can't quite reach the water. Nothing urgent, just a heads up.
Something's in the way. I'll wait it out.
combo_skill.townstead.charcutier.descrip: The butcher's block and the kitchen meet in cured meat. You gain 1 extra XP in both crafts whenever you complete work.
organization_role.townstead.faction_lead: Leads the faction, manages its identity and welcomes members.
organization_kind.townstead.player_facti: A faction led by its appointed leader.
